QuestInfo.name: The Miracle of Life 2
QuestInfo.0: You were able to save the egg by raising its temperature but you know nothing else about it. What is the deal with it anyway? Go ask Kumo.
QuestInfo.1: The egg doesn't have much time left until it hatches. It would be sad to watch it hatch without a mother. Kumo believes the monsters in the Minar Forest has done something with the egg's mother. Go find information on the mother by eliminating #r#o2600002##k and #r#o2600006##k.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated #r#o2600002##k and #r#o2600006##k but you learned nothing of the egg's mother.

0.0: Whew, we got its temperature back up, but it's still pretty sensitive. Whose egg is this anyway? It looks like it's about to hatch... Help me find its mom!

yes.0: The monsters in Minar Forest must've done something to the egg's mother. #r#o2600002##k and #r#o2600006##k monsters are really violent. Eliminate 15 of each and see if you can discover anything!

no.0: But the poor egg! It looks so lonely!

1.0: So, did you find any evidence?

yes.0: You didn't find anything, huh? It really must be alone...

mob.0: Hunting #r#o2600002##k and #r#o2600006##k monsters might give us a clue...
